macs_reference.source: Existing verified paper table2; reuse its reported rounded MAC value, not a new measurement.
macs_reference.precision_note: Rounded to 0.001G in original table; exact unrounded count not reconstructed.
macs_reference.convention: Original paper full-model count including selective scan; reuse recorded value.

inference_resources.timing_scope: CUDA-synchronized wall time around existing forward including tile assembly/clamp for tiled evaluation; excludes image decoding, H2D and quality metrics. Dataset evaluation wall time remains separate. No extra warmup/repeated images. Shared host contention and first-call overhead retained.
inference_resources.memory_scope: PyTorch process allocated/reserved peaks in MiB; forward includes resident model and input/target tensors. Evaluation peak also includes metric workspace. Not whole-device NVML usage; reserved may include allocator cache from earlier calls.
inference_resources.macs_scope: Reference batch1 RGB256x256 model MACs using recorded convention; per-image/tile call shapes also recorded. Do not treat reference MACs as a whole tiled evaluation count or measured hardware work.

boundary: Native full0. No additional outer padding. Original carrier boundaries.
limitation: Resource records include desktop/shared-host effects and first-call overhead.
